% A KOMA-Script document with hyperref and a list of its own from
% tocbasic's \DeclareNewTOC, shown with \listoftoc, beside the stale
% test-staleaux-toc-koma.lox of a PDF build without hyperref: three-argument
% \contentsline lines, which tex4ht's four-argument \contentsline reads past
% the end of the file. Its old entries are not in the page, and the stale
% file stays as it is.
\documentclass{scrreprt}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\DeclareNewTOC[type=example, types=examples, float, name=Example, listname={List of Examples}]{lox}
\begin{document}
\listoftoc{lox}
\chapter{First}
Text of the first chapter.
\begin{example}[h]
\centering An example.
\caption{New example}
\end{example}
\end{document}
